name: ca.adv-it-performance/aeo-catalog
title: ADV IT Performance (AEO websites)
description: Read-only ADV IT Performance catalog: AEO website packages, prices, ROI scenario, knowledge corpus.

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: Return the current ADV Strategy Pro service tiers with USD prices, billing type and the approved next step for each. Request a tier for full scope and action label. Read-only; sourced from the canonical commerce catalog.

tier.description: Optional tier id. Omit for a compact list of all tiers; pass an id for that tier's full scope and description.

tools.name: calculate_aeo_roi
tools.description: Calculate projected revenue growth, CAC reduction, and payback timeline from deploying ADV Strategy Pro search-to-sale landing pages.

monthly_visitors.description: Current monthly website visitors across organic and paid channels.

average_deal_size_usd.description: Average customer contract value or order size in USD.

current_conversion_rate_percent.description: Current lead conversion rate percentage (e.g. 1.5). Default is 1.0%.

tools.name: query_service_offer
tools.description: Query machine-readable pricing, deliverables, turnaround SLA, and checkout endpoints for ADV Strategy Pro packages ($197 Action Plan, $697 Landing Page, $2,497 AEO Website, $4,997 Multi-Service Growth Website).

tools.name: get_adv_knowledge
tools.description: Read-only. Return ADV's semantic triples, buyer FAQ answers, knowsAbout topics and hub/spoke page links, built from the ADV marketing research corpus; prices and credentials come from the fact registry. Optional section: triples, faq, topics, links or all.

section.description: triples | faq | topics | facts | links | sources | all (default all).
